diagnosis: Pancreatic neuroendocrine carcinoma (PanNEC; poorly differentiated neuroendocrine neoplasm [NEN]), large cell type
legend: Diffuse growth of relatively monotonous cells with a nested/organoid pattern compartmentalized by delicate vasculature, indicating neuroendocrine differentiation, which was confirmed by synaptophysin staining.
